title: Two conjectures in spectral hypergraph theory
summary: Let $\mathcal{A}$ be a $k$-th order $n$-dimensional tensor, and we denote by ${\rm am}(λ, \mathcal{A})$ the algebraic multiplicity of the eigenvalue $λ$ of $\mathcal{A}$. The projective eigenvariety $\mathbb{V}_λ(\mathcal{A})$ is defined as the set of eigenvectors of $\mathcal{A}$ associated with $λ$, considered in the complex projective space. For a connected uniform hypergraph $H$, let $\mathcal{A}(H)$ and $\mathcal{L}(H)$ denote its adjacency tensor and Laplacian tensor, respectively.
